legal_basis.title: Neuntes Gesetz zur Änderung des Bundeswahlgesetzes

summary.en: Berlin's members to be elected directly for the 12th Bundestag (ending their election by the Berlin House of Representatives); eight Berlin constituencies added; transitional provisions; amends § 53.
summary.zh-CN: 第12届联邦议院起柏林议员改为直选（不再由柏林众议院选出）；增设8个柏林选区；过渡性规定；修订第53条。

legal_basis.title: Gesetz zu dem Vertrag vom 3. August 1990 zur Vorbereitung und Durchführung der ersten gesamtdeutschen Wahl des Deutschen Bundestages zwischen der Bundesrepublik Deutschland und der Deutschen Demokratischen Republik

summary.en: Ratifies the election treaty signed on 3 August 1990: federal electoral law extended to the GDR Länder; Bundestag members raised from 518 to 656; constituencies 257–328 added for Mecklenburg-Vorpommern, Brandenburg, Sachsen-Anhalt, Sachsen, Thüringen and East Berlin; list associations of different parties admitted for the first all-German election; Berlin treated as one Land; shortened deadlines.
summary.zh-CN: 批准1990年8月3日签署的选举条约：联邦选举法扩展适用于民主德国各州；联邦议院议员由518名增至656名；为梅克伦堡-前波莫瑞、勃兰登堡、萨克森-安哈尔特、萨克森、图林根及东柏林增设第257–328号选区；首次全德选举允许不同政党的名单联合；柏林作为一个州对待；缩短期限。

legal_basis.title: Zehntes Gesetz zur Änderung des Bundeswahlgesetzes sowie zur Änderung des Parteiengesetzes

summary.en: Adapts the electoral law for the 12th Bundestag to the Federal Constitutional Court's judgment of 29 September 1990: the threshold is applied to two separate electoral areas (the territories of the two German states before 3 October 1990); list associations admitted for parties and other political associations seated in the former GDR; amends § 53 of the Federal Electoral Act.
summary.zh-CN: 依联邦宪法法院1990年9月29日判决调整第12届联邦议院选举法：门槛分别适用于两个选举区域（1990年10月3日前两个德国国家的领土）；允许总部位于前民主德国的政党及其他政治团体组成名单联合；修订《联邦选举法》第53条。

legal_basis_dates: adopted_by_bundestag and promulgated as printed in the Bundestag Datenhandbuch; entry-into-force dates are not printed there and are not asserted (in_force: null)

notes.en: Reunification election (first all-German Bundestag). 656 statutory seats (328 constituencies, 328 list seats) plus 6 overhang seats = 662. Hare/Niemeyer allocation of 656 seats by second votes. The 5% threshold was applied separately in the two electoral areas — former Federal territory with West Berlin, and new Länder with East Berlin — not nationwide: PDS (2.4% nationally, 11.1% in the eastern area) and Bündnis 90/Grüne (1.2%, 6.1% east) took seats, while the western GRÜNE (3.8% nationally, 4.8% in the western area) did not. The official tables report the two areas separately and Hare/Niemeyer reproduces every party's seats only with this rule; the Tenth Act amending the Federal Electoral Act (promulgated 10 October 1990, BGBl. I S. 2141), adopted after the Federal Constitutional Court's judgment of 29 September 1990, set this separate-area threshold.
notes.zh-CN: 两德统一后的首次全德联邦议院选举。法定席位656席（328个选区、328个名单席位），另有6个超额席位，共662席。按第二票以Hare/Niemeyer方法分配656席。5%门槛在两个选举区域分别适用（原联邦地区及西柏林；新联邦州及东柏林），而非全国统一适用：民社党（全国2.4%，东部11.1%）与联盟90/绿党（全国1.2%，东部6.1%）获得席位，西部绿党（全国3.8%，西部4.8%）未获席位。官方统计分两个区域列示，且仅在此规则下Hare/Niemeyer方法能复现各党席位；该规则由1990年10月10日公布的《联邦选举法第十修正法》（BGBl. I S. 2141）确立，系依联邦宪法法院1990年9月29日判决而通过。

summary.en: Proposal to regionalise the 5% clause again (as in 1990) and lower it to 3% for the 13th Bundestag; rejected in second reading on 1994-01-20. The 1994 election therefore used one national threshold.
summary.zh-CN: 关于第13届联邦议院再次按区域适用5%条款（如1990年）并降至3%的提案，于1994年1月20日二读时被否决。因此1994年选举适用全国统一门槛。

notes.en: 656 statutory seats (328 constituencies, 328 list seats) plus 16 overhang seats = 672. Hare/Niemeyer allocation of 656 seats by second votes among parties with at least 5% of the national second votes or at least three constituency seats (basic-mandate clause). In 1994 the PDS (4.4%) took part through the basic-mandate clause with four constituency seats. Overhang seats were not compensated.
notes.zh-CN: 法定席位656席（328个选区、328个名单席位），另有16个超额席位，共672席。在全国第二票达到5%或赢得至少三个选区席位（基本议席条款）的政党之间，按第二票以Hare/Niemeyer方法分配656席。1994年民社党（4.4%）凭四个选区席位依基本议席条款参与分配。超额席位不予补偿。
